title: cli/docs: the meta.getItem draft-read example casts item, and os lint --item points at os meta register --mode draft
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTyMahdAdhXSzgy2nt

Filing gate: ② follow-up of accepted review nits · Source: fleet · L2 record 7026697115 on PR #35675 (#34777), nits F1 and F3. Seat 1 adopted them as accepted deviations in 7026743852 and ordered one card for both. ⛔ Not a claim. Under seat 1's p1-only rule (Sales, 2026-11-20 00:37Z), this card waits in the queue.

Grade: left to triage. The seat suggests **p3**: both are wording fixes and neither changes behaviour. Size S, `area:build`.
Blocked-by: #34777

## Business reason

PR #35675 adds two things for an author who writes metadata item by item: the SDK draft read, and `os meta register --mode draft`, which prints the publish verdict of the saved draft. Two pieces of text that ship with it point authors to the wrong place.

## What happens

- **F1.** `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:234` reads `draft.item._diagnostics?.valid`. `GetMetaItemResponse.item` is typed `unknown`, so a TypeScript reader who copies the example gets a type error. The CLI's own code (`packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts`, `draftPublishVerdictOf`) casts `item` first.
- **F3.** `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts:1479`: the `os lint --item` text output ends with "Run `os lint` on the project, or publish the draft, for those." Since #35675, `os meta register --mode draft --package <id>` shows the full publish verdict without anything going live. "Publish the draft" sends the author to a step that makes the item live.

## Expected

- The SDK example casts `item` the way the CLI does, and the example compiles as written.
- The `--item` hint names `os meta register --mode draft --package <id>` as the way to see the rules that could not be judged alone, beside `os lint` on the project. The JSON face carries the same hint if it has one.

## Done when

The example on that page type-checks, and the `--item` text output shows the new hint. If the hint wording is pinned, the pin in `packages/cli/test/lint-item.test.ts` moves with it.

Who acts: area b1-B of repo:objectstack#1 when the queue reaches p3, or triage routes it.
Dedupe: the card follows review nits on an unmerged PR; nothing earlier names them.
